Features

Real-Time Scanning
Just drop your video link, and within seconds, know if your song is safe to use. That means you can publish your content faster without worrying about copyright strikes.
99.99% Accuracy
Our tool scans a massive database of copyrighted music worldwide. We search through popular tracks, indie music, and even lesser-known songs. So you can trust the results you get.
User-Friendly Experience
Our YouTube music copyright checker is created for everyone, especially beginners, to make copyright checks simple. Just copy and paste a link or type in a song name, and you're good to go.
TubeMusic

TubeMusic is a 100% free platform that lets you find copyright‑free and royalty‑free music for your YouTube videos. You can check the copyright status of each song before using it or browse our ready-made library of copyright‑free tracks.
